title: International study for children and adolescents with standard risk ALK-positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma (ALCL) estimating the efficacy of Vinblastine
official: International cooperative prospective study for children and adolescents with standard risk ALK-positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma (ALCL) estimating the efficacy of Vinblastine
summary: Main objective: To show that it is possible to cure at least 75% of patients belonging to the SR group with Vinblastine-monotherapy for 24 months.
conditions: standard risk ALK-positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma (ALCL)
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Stratification into the standard risk group (SR) by screening: Newly diagnosed ALK-positive ALCL, Stage I not completely resected, or stage II or stage III, MDD negative
2. Age < 18 years
3. Informed consent of the parents/legal guardians (and assent of the competent child) for study participation and data collection, storage and handling given before study entry
4. Participation in national / study group's reference pathology
5. Follow-up for at least 3 years after enrolment is expected
6. Application of a highly effective contraceptive method (Pearl index <1) in sexually active patients
7. Application of one intrathecal triple therapy with Methotrexate, Cytarabine and Prednisolone (or Hydrocortisone respectively) before start of the protocol treatment
Exclusion criteria:
1. Progressive disease during a possible clinically indicated pre-phase treatment before inclusion in the study
2. Steroids for more than 2 days or chemotherapy pre-treatment before taking the screening sample for MDD
3. Chemotherapy pre-treatment before start of the study treatment except for: the obligatory initial intrathecal triple therapy with Methotrexate, Cytarabine and Prednisolone (or Hydrocortisone respectively), a possible clinically indicated pre-phase including up to 5 days of steroids combined with up to 3 doses of Vinblastine (and up to 2 doses of Cyclophosphamide)
4. Pregnancy or lactation period
5. Contraindications for the treatment with Vinblastine: hypersensitivity against VBL or other vinca-alkaloids, leukopenia, other than in the context of the ALCL, severe uncontrolled infection
6. Other medical, psychiatric, familial or social condition prohibiting treatment according to the protocol
